P3_PY_MUT_STEP9_VAL_MAJ_01_correction.defect: The original artifact labeled all three approved-gate conditions FAIL — criteria, including condition 3 (mutation-surface completeness for the 5 high-materiality blind-spot methods). Chapter 13 SS13.8/SS13.9 distinguishes FAIL — criteria (a valid, complete measurement simply does not meet the bar) from FAIL — evidence (required evidence is missing/invalid/unresolvable). Condition 3 is the latter: no qualifying supplemental mutation-testing mechanism, governed deterministic fault-injection evidence, or explicit Product Owner risk-acceptance exists for any of the 5 high-materiality methods -- this is a genuine EVIDENCE GAP (nothing to measure against), not a measured-but-failing criterion.

Nothing was measured against condition 3 because the code is unreachable by the accepted mechanism and no alternative evidence exists.
